pos.description: [x, y]; x grows east, y grows south

state_ticks_left.description: tick resolutions until the state ends, counting the tick you reply to; 1 = it ends this tick; 0 when idle

slow_ticks_left.description: ticks until the frostburst area you are standing in explodes, counting this tick (0 = not slowed); dash is unaffected

buffs.description: active pickup buffs (power) → ticks left, counting the tick you reply to

cooldowns.description: ticks until each ability is usable (move, dash, and every attack); 0 = ready

budget_ms_left.description: response time left in the match budget

pos.description: [x, y]; x grows east, y grows south

dash_cooldown.description: ticks until this opponent can dash again; 0 = ready

buffs.description: active pickup buffs (power) → ticks left, counting the tick you reply to

enemies.description: visible opponents only (sight radius 8, walls block)

exact_pos.description: position in thousandths of a tile; tile centres are multiples of 1000

origin.description: it flies the straight line from the centre of origin through the centre of target, until it hits a wall or fighter (after its bounces, if any)

target.description: [x, y]; x grows east, y grows south

speed.description: tiles per tick along the line's major axis

bounces_left.description: wall bounces it has left (a new standard shot has 1); after a bounce, origin and target describe the reflected line

tile.description: [x, y]; x grows east, y grows south

moves.description: steps you could start this tick, with the tile each reaches: off cooldown, not into a wall, past a wall corner or into a fighter. Empty if your move is on cooldown or you can't act. Legal now, not guaranteed: simultaneous moves into one tile still both fail

tile.description: [x, y]; x grows east, y grows south

distance.description: tiles covered: the full dash distance, or less if a wall or fighter stops it early

dashes.description: dashes you could start this tick, with the landing tile. Empty if your dash is on cooldown or you can't act; a dash that wouldn't move is left out

id.description: pad id, as listed in hello.pickups

pos.description: [x, y]; x grows east, y grows south

ready_in.description: 0 = on the pad now (step on it to take it); otherwise ticks until it reappears

pickups.description: pickup pads in sight; every pad's position is in hello.pickups

pos.description: [x, y]; x grows east, y grows south

slow.description: extra move cooldown for opponents standing on `tiles` until it detonates; 0 = none

ticks_left.description: 1 = detonates during the tick you reply to

items.description: [x, y]; x grows east, y grows south

tiles.description: exact blast footprint after wall occlusion

center.description: [x, y]; x grows east, y grows south

radius.description: Chebyshev radius of the safe square; outside it you take zone damage

next_radius.description: radius after the next shrink; null unless a shrink is within 20 ticks

shrinks_in.description: ticks until the next shrink; null unless within 20 ticks

tile.description: [x, y]; x grows east, y grows south

tick.description: tick the hit resolves on; equal to this observation's tick = during the tick you reply to, after movement

damage.description: base damage, before the attacker's power buff

danger.description: every tile each visible opponent projectile and area will hit, and on which tick, in tick order. Attacks fire the tick they are sent, so one sent this tick appears next tick. Paths stop at walls but ignore fighters

part.description: the part of the turn that was refused: "move", "dash", "attack", "shout", "turn" (all of it but a shout), or "(message)" for a server-side failure

detail.description: for server-side failures: what was wrong, e.g. which field failed the schema

ricochet.description: present when the shot hit after bouncing off a wall

target.description: the aimed tile; the attacker's own tile for the repulsor, which has no aim
